import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 205;
    static final int M = N * N;
    static int[] head, nxt, to, cap;
    static int ec;

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int uv, int vu) {
        nxt[ec] = head[u]; to[ec] = v; cap[ec] = uv; head[u] = ec++;
        nxt[ec] = head[v]; to[ec] = u; cap[ec] = vu; head[v] = ec++;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int sink, int flow, boolean[] mark) {
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        if (mark[v]) return 0;
        mark[v] = true;
        for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
            if (cap[e] > 0) {
                int u = to[e];
                int x = dfs(u, sink, Math.min(flow, cap[e]), mark);
                if (x > 0) {
                    cap[e] -= x;
                    cap[e ^ 1] += x;
                    return x;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow(int source, int sink, int nodeCount) {
        int res = 0;
        boolean[] mark = new boolean[nodeCount];
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(mark, false);
            int add = dfs(source, sink, 2000000000, mark);
            res += add;
            if (add == 0) break;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int dt = sc.nextInt();
        int m = n * n;
        int nodeCount = 2 * m + 5; // enough for all node indices used
        head = new int[nodeCount];
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        nxt = new int[M];
        to = new int[M];
        cap = new int[M];
        ec = 0;

        int[][] a = new int[n][n];
        int[][] b = new int[n][n];
        boolean[][] red = new boolean[n][n];
        boolean[][] block = new boolean[n][n];

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c == 'Y') block[x][y] = true;
                else if (c == 'Z') red[x][y] = true;
                else a[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') b[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }

        int[][] dis = new int[m][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], 1000000000);
            dis[i][i] = 0;
        }
        int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (block[x][y] || red[x][y]) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                    if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j]) {
                        dis[x * n + y][i * n + j] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (dis[i][k] + dis[k][j] < dis[i][j]) {
                        dis[i][j] = dis[i][k] + dis[k][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dred = new int[m];
        Arrays.fill(dred, 1000000000);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red[i][j]) {
                    dred[i * n + j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                int id = i * n + j;
                if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j] && dred[id] > 1000000000) {
                    dred[id] = dred[x * n + y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int source = N - 2, sink = N - 1;
        boolean[] seen = new boolean[m];
        for (int cur = 0; cur < m; cur++) {
            int sx = cur / n, sy = cur % n;
            if (block[sx][sy] || red[sx][sy]) continue;
            Arrays.fill(seen, false);
            Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
            q2.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
            seen[cur] = true;
            while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                int[] p = q2.poll();
                int x = p[0], y = p[1];
                int id = x * n + y;
                if (dis[cur][id] <= dt) {
                    add_edge(cur << 1, (id << 1) | 1, 1000, 0);
                }
                if (dis[cur][id] == dred[id]) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                    int nid = i * n + j;
                    if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j] &&
                        dis[cur][nid] <= dred[nid] && dis[cur][nid] <= dt &&
                        dis[cur][nid] > dis[cur][id] && !seen[nid]) {
                        seen[nid] = true;
                        q2.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                add_edge(source, (i * n + j) << 1, a[i][j], 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                add_edge((i * n + j) << 1 | 1, sink, b[i][j], 0);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow(source, sink, nodeCount));
    }
}
